_doc: THE currency token list for this skill. ONE list, read by every checker that has to recognise a money cell, so no checker can silently miss a currency the others know. ORDER MATTERS: multi-character prefixes (R$, A$, HK$) precede the bare $ so the longer token wins the alternation. Match with (?![A-Za-z]) after the token, never \b, which silently fails on a 3-letter code followed by a magnitude suffix like CHF43B.
_subunit_doc: GBPence, GBp, ZARc and ILAgorot are SUBUNIT tokens and are listed so a checker RECOGNISES such a cell instead of silently skipping it. They are deliberately NOT rescaled anywhere: 'GBPence0.8337' is 0.8337 pence, not pounds, and dividing by 100 is a rendering decision with output consequences that must be made on purpose rather than inherited from a regex. meta.money_scale is 'B' or 'M' today, so no subunit cell can reach a page; if one ever can, the scale layer is where the division belongs. Ordered before the 3-letter codes so GBPence beats GBP on the same string.
